entries.summary: A Background work card above the composer shows running agents, commands and /background tasks with their status, and a finished /background result until you dismiss it, the same on every device.
A delegation step in the chat now shows how many of its subagents are done or failed, and updates as they finish.
Background work and its results survive a reload, a server restart and a reopened app, and checking on them from one device no longer hides a result from another.
